super_agent.name: Stage1_SuperOrchestrator
super_agent.description: Master Front-End RTL & Verification Orchestrator driving 11 Sub-Agents with Zero-Hallucination Policy

sub_agents.name: subagent_1_1_microarch
sub_agents.description: Establishes hardware spec, register map, pinouts, and FSM state transition diagrams.

sub_agents.name: subagent_1_2_rtl_coder
sub_agents.description: Generates clean synthesizable Verilog/SystemVerilog with strict blocking/non-blocking rules.

sub_agents.name: subagent_1_3_static_linter
sub_agents.description: Runs Verilator --lint-only -Wall, parses stdout logs, and auto-patches RTL latches and width truncations.

sub_agents.name: subagent_1_4_cdc_auditor
sub_agents.description: Audits clock domain crossings, synchronizers, Async FIFOs, and reset de-assertion paths.

sub_agents.name: subagent_1_5_tb_bfm_setup
sub_agents.description: Constructs testbenches, bus functional models (BFMs), scoreboards, and golden reference models.

sub_agents.name: subagent_1_6_directed_sim
sub_agents.description: Compiles and runs directed test cases via Icarus Verilog (iverilog/vvp).

sub_agents.name: subagent_1_7_random_testing
sub_agents.description: Injects randomized inputs to uncover unexpected state machine deadlocks and corner cases.

sub_agents.name: subagent_1_8_code_coverage
sub_agents.description: Evaluates Line, Branch, Toggle, and FSM State Coverage metrics.

sub_agents.name: subagent_1_9_functional_sva
sub_agents.description: Monitors Covergroups and SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA) for protocol compliance.

sub_agents.name: subagent_1_10_verifier
sub_agents.description: Independently verifies all sub-agent outputs for physical accuracy, zero hallucination, and web-searches any uncertain specifications.

sub_agents.name: subagent_1_11_signoff_gate
sub_agents.description: Audits all 10 stage reports + Output Verifier approval and issues final Front-End Signoff Certificate.
